steps.name: apply-climate-io-adapter-and-doc-sync
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=c7da0e33a82680558b2f27d85652d7d8e43d72c3; git fetch origin mvp/environment-controller agent-control; git reset --hard origin/mvp/environment-controller; git clean -fd; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage24/apply_stage24a_climate_io_adapter.py > /tmp/apply-stage24a-climate-io-adapter.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage24/sync_stage24a_docs.py > /tmp/sync-stage24a-docs.py; .venv/bin/python /tmp/apply-stage24a-climate-io-adapter.py; .venv/bin/python /tmp/sync-stage24a-docs.py; .venv/bin/pre-commit run clang-format --files src/climate/ClimateIoAdapters.h src/climate/ClimateIoAdapters.cpp test/test_climate_io_adapters/test_main.cpp || true; .venv/bin/pre-commit run clang-format --files src/climate/ClimateIoAdapters.h src/climate/ClimateIoAdapters.cpp test/test_climate_io_adapters/test_main.cpp; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-climate-io-adapter-and-doc-checks
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --target climate_io_adapter_tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests -R '^climate_io_adapter_tests$' --output-on-failure; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --files src/climate/ClimateIoAdapters.h src/climate/ClimateIoAdapters.cpp test/test_climate_io_adapters/test_main.cpp README.md docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/CHANGELOG.md docs/PROJECT_LAYOUT.md docs/MVP_HARDWARE_SENSOR_SET.md docs/INTEGRATION_CONVERGENCE.md docs/PORTING_TO_LITEGRAPH.md AGENTS.md; grep -F 'ESP-IDF 5.5.4' README.md; grep -F 'ClimateInputAdapter' docs/ARCHITECTURE.md; grep -F 'Local Agent v4.10.2' AGENTS.md; if grep -E 'ESP-IDF 5\.5\.1|Local Agent v4\.9\.6' README.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/CHANGELOG.md AGENTS.md; then exit 1; fi; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-idf-v5-5-4-and-publish-stage24a
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -A; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; unset VIRTUAL_ENV CONDA_PREFIX PYTHONHOME || true; export PATH='/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin'; source "$HOME/esp/esp-idf/export.sh"; idf.py --version | grep -F 'ESP-IDF v5.5.4'; rm -rf build/idf-gate; bash scripts/idf_gate_build.sh; git diff --check; git add -A; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Add climate I/O adapter seam and refresh docs'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; printf 'PUBLISHED_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
